icons.name: face-with-tears-of-joy
icons.heading: Face with tears of joy
icons.description: Laughing so hard that tears burst out. Light: one laugh kicks the head up and it lands, and a fresh tear spurts out of each eye-corner tear in a short arc outward and down, then fades. Strong: the head dips first, then two laugh beats (the second smaller) tip it back and forth, the grin opens wider on the first beat and the tears spurt farther.

Strong: a deeper squeeze before a bigger beat, the rays flicking farther, then a second and a third, smaller, beat before it rests.

icons.name: rolling-on-the-floor-laughing
icons.heading: Rolling on the floor laughing
icons.description: Laughing so hard it rolls over. The tilted tears-of-joy face rocks back, then rolls one whole turn on the spot, flinging a droplet off each tear as it spins. Light: a slight rock back and one even turn. Strong: a deeper wind-up, a faster turn that travels a little and hops, a landing bounce, and the tears flung farther.

Strong: a deeper wind-up tipped back, a higher jab that tilts the thumb forward, hits and rebounds, and two short sparks flash off the thumb tip at the hit.

icons.description: A thank-you bow: two palms pressed together, fingers up, sleeves at the wrists. Strong: a firmer press, a deeper bow, a quick rise and a second, smaller bow, and the rays reach farther.

icons.name: face-with-rolling-eyes
icons.heading: Face with rolling eyes
icons.description: An eye roll. Light: the pupils roll one whole circuit round the inside of the eyes, from the top and back to it, as the head tips back a little. Strong: the pupils wind back first, then roll slower and further, overshooting the top and settling, while the head tips back further and the mouth slides to one side in a sigh.
